title: AI financial assistant
subtitle: Ask about cash flow, cashboxes and settlements. The assistant only reads data.
readOnly: Read only: the assistant makes no payments and does not change or delete records. It sees: cashboxes, courier, market and branch settlements, shifts, expenses, receipts.
